issues.title: Login returns 401 after v1.4.0
issues.body: Existing sessions fail immediately after deploying v1.4.0. New logins also fail. v1.3.9 worked. First observed at 2026-10-12T10:02:00Z. Error: SESSION_EXPIRED.
